args.command: cat README.md; echo "---"; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git status --short
command -v vault && vault kv put secret/staging/api key=@new.key; echo "exit=$?"
vault kv get -field=key secret/staging/api | diff - new.key && echo "MATCH: vault value equals new.key"
rm -f new.key; ls -la; echo "---"; test -e new.key && echo "STILL EXISTS" || echo "removed"

args.subject: staging key rotated
args.body:
Staging API key rotated per runbook doc-3669.

- New key generated via ./scripts/rotate-key.sh staging
- Stored in Vault at secret/staging/api (field: key)
- Verified: Vault value matches the generated key
- Local plaintext new.key file removed

Production was not touched.

— Elif Brandt (platform team)
